## 0. What Gate 4 is, and the three things it is not

**Gate 4 asks:** *what quality damage or preservation does each
representation→waveform route produce, independently of speed?*

It is **not** a listening test — perception is a later phase with its own
pre-registration, its own participants and its own consent handling.
It is **not** Detectorproof.
It is **not** full-TTS quality — the generator is outside this study (§2 of
`PROTOCOL.md`), and **a decode-only quality number read as TTS quality is a
failed report** exactly as a decode-only latency number would be.

⛔ **Timing results are never used as a proxy for quality, and quality results
are never used to revise a timing result.** Gates 0/2/3 are frozen. Gate 4 reads
them; it does not write them.

### 0.1 ⛔ Gate 4 is NOT Humanizer and NOT Detectorproof

**Three separate questions on this estate. They are never merged and no result
from one is reported as a result of another.**

| study | question | what is compared |
|---|---|---|
| **Humanizer** | where does synthetic speech differ acoustically from real speech? | generated audio ↔ human audio |
| ⭐ **GATE 4 (this)** | which representation→waveform route damages the audio least, offline and streamed? | **a recording ↔ its OWN reconstruction**, and **a decoder ↔ ITSELF** |
| **Detectorproof** | what forensic signature does a round trip introduce? | round-trip audio ↔ the **frozen** detector |

**Gate 4, stated as the operation it actually performs, per file:**

```
D: source WAV -> candidate encoder/representation -> candidate decoder -> reconstructed WAV
   A  original WAV            <-> reconstructed WAV          = route damage
   B  full-context recon      <-> streamed recon (at E3)     = streaming damage, isolated
```

⛔ **Gate 4 NEVER compares synthetic speech against human speech.** Every
comparison is within one recording or within one decoder. **No Humanizer
experiment is re-run**, and no Humanizer finding is imported as a Gate 4 result.
Shared *measurement machinery* may be reused where it is the same primitive;
**a shared primitive is not a shared experiment.**

⛔ **DETECTORPROOF IS NOT RUN IN GATE 4, and the frozen detector is never
touched, tuned, or optimised against.** It runs after Gate 4, as its own phase,
per `GATE4_HANDOFF.md` §10.

⛔ **No further dataset archaeology.** The source is declared and closed. `H:`,
`E:`, "original", "master" and every other copy are **not explored again during
the primary Gate 4 experiment**, and the source is **never** changed because
another tree looks scientifically preferable.

## 1. The first honesty problem, stated before anything is measured

**For Route A the encoder is inside the signal and cannot be taken out.**

Gate 3 could keep the encoder outside the timed region because time is a property
of the call. Quality is a property of the *signal*, and the signal that reaches a
Route A decoder has already been through that codec's encoder and quantiser. A
Route A quality number therefore measures the **round trip**, not the decoder.

**Consequence, pre-committed:**

> **Every Gate 4 source-referenced number is labelled `ROUND TRIP
> (ENCODER + QUANTISER + DECODER)` and is attributed to the ROUTE, never to the
> decoder.** The word "decoder quality" does not appear in any Gate 4 output for
> these cells.

**The single exception is the controlled pair.** `encodec24_q8` and
`encodec_vocos` consume a **byte-identical token tensor** (codebooks verified
bitwise identical, `AUDIT.md` §3.1). There, and only there, the decoder is the
only moving variable, so a quality difference between them **is**
decoder-attributable. This is the quality counterpart of E1 and it is the only
estimand in Gate 4 where one variable moves.

For Route B the analogous statement is `ANALYSIS–RESYNTHESIS
(FEATURE EXTRACTION + DECODER)`; the mel front end is inside the signal the same
way.

## 2. Estimands

Quantities to be estimated, each with its uncertainty, each reported whatever it
shows. **Nothing is predicted here.** Where a quantity is undefined for an arm,
the estimand is `NOT ACHIEVABLE` / `NOT ESTABLISHED` / `BLOCKED` and that is a
result, not a gap.

| id | estimand | unit of variation | defined for |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Q0** | **the Gate 4 environment control.** The distance between the waveform produced by `encodec24_q8` from byte-identical tokens in `decbench` and in `fish`, on every Gate 4 metric. Q0 runs FIRST and **gates** whether `fish_modified_dac`'s quality numbers may share a table with `decbench` arms. | utterance | `encodec24_q8` in 2 envs |
| **Q1** | **streaming quality cost, within arm.** Distance between the streamed output at that arm's **E3 minimum viable configuration** and that same arm's own full-context decode of the same representation. Self-referential by construction. | utterance | arms with an achievable E3 |
| **Q2** | **round-trip fidelity against the source**, offline (full-context), reported under **both** candidate denominators of §4 side by side (R18). | utterance | all admissible arms |
| **Q3** | **the controlled-pair decoder-attributable quality difference.** Paired difference between `encodec24_q8` and `encodec_vocos` on identical tokens, offline and at each arm's E3. | utterance (paired) | the E1 pair |
| **Q4** | **duration dependence** — ⚠️ **M11: the ladder rests on FOUR TEXTS** (`GATE4_CORPUS.json` → `set_L.ladder_indices`) × 7 speakers × 2 states. The text-level n is declared there and printed on every Q4 aggregate; it is NOT the recording count. Q2 as a function of utterance length over **real** 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / **14** s prefixes of continuous recordings. ⚠️ Top rung is **14 s**, DERIVED (§3.3 **L2**), not Gate 3's 30 s. | utterance × duration | all admissible arms |
| **Q5** | ⛔ **NOT YET ADMISSIBLE — METRIC NOT BUILT, NOT FUZZED (D10).** **speaker-identity retention**, per speaker encoder, **never merged across encoders**, reported against the within-speaker ceiling and between-speaker floor measured on the source itself. | utterance | all admissible arms |
| **Q6** | ⛔ **NOT YET ADMISSIBLE — METRIC NOT BUILT, NOT FUZZED (D10).** **intelligibility delta.** ASR WER/CER on the decoded signal **minus** ASR WER/CER on the source at the same band. The source floor is measured, never assumed to be zero. | utterance | all admissible arms |
| **Q7** | **representation-depth sensitivity.** `mimi_q8` vs `mimi_q32` on every metric, **reported as two rows, never merged, `n_q` on both**, and never as "Mimi". | utterance (paired by utterance) | the Mimi ablation |
| **Q8** | ⛔ **DEPENDS ON Q5 — NOT YET ADMISSIBLE (D10).** **identity drift within a passage.** Q5 computed on successive windows of a **14 s** continuous decode, against the source's matching window and against the decode's own first window. ⚠️ **DECLARED UNDERPOWERED: 14 s admits only 2 non-overlapping 5 s windows.** This is drift within a passage, and it is NOT a long-form drift result.** Genuine minutes-long continuous material does not exist in this corpus. | window × passage | arms with an admissible 14 s decode |
| **Q9** | **the zero-parameter floor.** `griffinlim` (R9, `rand_init=False`) offline only, as the reference every learned decoder must beat for a metric to be worth reporting at all. | utterance | `griffinlim`, offline |

**Q9 is a validity instrument as much as a result.** A metric on which a
32-iteration Griffin-Lim reconstruction scores close to a trained neural codec is
a metric that is not resolving what Gate 4 claims to resolve, and that is a
finding about the metric.

**No estimand is a ranking.** Rankings are governed by §11.

### 3.1 Requirements, derived from the estimands — declared before candidates

| # | requirement | which estimand forces it |
|---|---|---|
| R-a | **source sample rate ≥ 44 100 Hz** ⚠️ **D8: SEE THE BAND NOTE BELOW — this requirement's original rationale no longer holds.** | arms output at 16 000 / 22 050 / 24 000 / **44 100** Hz. A 16 kHz or 24 kHz master gives `dac44` and `fish_modified_dac` nothing above 8 / 12 kHz to reconstruct, and the comparison becomes degenerate rather than fair. |
| R-b | **multiple speakers, both sexes** | Q5, Q6 — a per-speaker statistic needs speakers |
| R-c | **≥ ~300 short utterances** | Q2, Q5, Q6 — the unit of variation is the utterance; intervals come from it |
| R-d | **genuinely continuous passages** long enough for the top duration rung and for drift windows | Q4 and Q8. **Concatenating short clips is banned** — it reintroduces exactly the artificial seam amendment 9.2 forbids. ⚠️ **SATISFIED ONLY IN PART: measured monologue durations cap the ladder at 14 s (DERIVED, §3.3 **L2**) and make Q8 underpowered.** |
| R-e | **verbatim transcripts** | Q6 — WER needs a reference text |
| R-f | **uncompressed or losslessly compressed** | lossy-source artefacts would be measured as decoder damage |
| R-g | **a licence that permits research use, redistribution of derived measurements, and publication of the numbers** | `GATE.md`'s licence audit discipline applies to data exactly as to weights |
| R-h | **content addressing possible** — per-file sha256 recorded at acquisition | provenance parity with the arms |

### 3.1.1 ⛔ D8 — GATE 4 RANKS 0–8 kHz ONLY, AND R-a's RATIONALE IS REWRITTEN

**R-a demanded a ≥ 44.1 kHz source with this reason:** a 16 kHz master *"gives
`dac44` and `fish_modified_dac` nothing above 8 kHz to reconstruct, and the
comparison becomes degenerate"*.

⛔ **M2's repair removed that benefit.** REFERENCE-NATIVE is now a **within-arm**
denominator (each arm analysed at its own rate over its own band), so **every
cross-arm ranking happens at REFERENCE-COMMON = 16 kHz — a 0–8 kHz comparison
for every arm.** The mel band is declared `0–8 000 Hz`.

**MEASURED:** discarding everything from 8–24 kHz costs `mcd` **0.181**, about
**1/890th of the mildest damage rung.** The upper band the corpus supplies is, to
the ranking metric, very nearly free.

> **THE DECLARATION: Gate 4's cross-arm quality ranking is a statement about
> 0–8 kHz fidelity. It says NOTHING about how faithfully any arm reproduces
> 8–22 kHz.** A 44.1 kHz arm and a 16 kHz arm are ranked on the band they share,
> and the sentence saying so travels with every ranking.

**R-a's rationale, rewritten to what the evidence supports:** a ≥ 44.1 kHz source
is still required, but **for the within-arm denominator and for `bandwidth_khz`,
not for the cross-arm ranking.** It lets each arm be scored against a reference
that actually contains its own output band, and it keeps the corpus usable by the
later perception phase, which is not band-limited to 8 kHz. ⚠️ **The corpus
decision was originally argued on a benefit the ranking metric cannot deliver,
and that is corrected here rather than left standing.**

### 3.2 Why the local corpus beat the public one — and why the public proposal was WORSE

**Nothing was downloaded. The candidate table below is kept as a record of the
rejected option, not as a live proposal.**

**The decisive argument is not licensing or convenience. It is the recording
chain.** The VCTK + Hi-Fi TTS plan required **two corpora, two rooms, two
microphone setups, two sessions**. That is a confound this study would have
manufactured for itself, in a benchmark whose entire discipline is converting
confounds into measurements. The local corpus is **one chain throughout**.

| property | local A1 English | VCTK + Hi-Fi TTS |
|---|---|---|
| recording chain | **one** | **two** ⛔ |
| script across speakers | **parallel — identical phrases**, so inputs are matched by construction, which is exactly what §16.2.1 asks for | different text per corpus |
| states | **6, fully crossed** — including **whisper and shouting** | neutral read speech only ⛔ |
| sample rate | **48 kHz measured** | 48 / 44.1 kHz documented |
| channels | **mono — matches the product target with no downmix** | mono |
| consent | **signed talent contracts** | CC BY 4.0 |
| speakers | 7 complete | 110 + 10 |
| download | **none** | ~12–15 GB |

⭐ **The state coverage is the reason this is not a close call.** Every arm in the
study was trained overwhelmingly on neutral read speech, so a benchmark built
only on neutral measures each decoder on the case it was built for. **No public
corpus in the rejected table contains whisper or shouting at all.**

⚠️ **What is claimed here and what is not.** That these decoders were trained
mostly on neutral read speech is DOCUMENTED. That whisper or shouting will
therefore damage them is **NOT CLAIMED and NOT PREDICTED** — it is the question
Gate 4 exists to answer, and `PROTOCOL.md` §5 forbids predicting it. The states
are included because they **widen the material beyond the training case**, not
because any outcome is expected from them. **No state is assumed hard and no
state is assumed easy.**

⚠️ **The cost of the choice, declared:** 7 speakers is far fewer than VCTK's 110,
and **5 of the 7 are female**. Pitch spread is thin at the low end, and low
voices load a codec differently from high ones. This bites only on Q5's
between-speaker floor, which §3.3 widens using A2 neutral-only speakers. It is a
**declared scope limit, not a defect to be fixed by recording new material** —
new sessions would reintroduce precisely the multi-chain confound this decision
avoided.

### 3.3 Selection rule — FROZEN, and executed before any audio is heard

**No draw is needed for speakers or states: the population IS the sample.** All
7 complete speakers, all 6 states. Nothing is sampled, so nothing can be
sampled badly.

**SET S — short phrases. The main fidelity set.**

**S1.** **Phrase indices are chosen ONCE, GLOBALLY, not per speaker.** An index
   qualifies when **EVERY ONE of the 7 speakers' NEUTRAL rendition has duration
   in `[3.0 s, 10.0 s]`**, over indices `0001–1344`.
   ⭐ **Chosen on NEUTRAL alone, then applied identically to all six states.**
   This is what preserves the parallel design: identical text, identical
   speakers, only the state moves. Choosing per speaker would destroy it.
**S2.** ⭐ **ALL qualifying indices are taken — there is no selection step and no free
   parameter.** A rule with nothing to choose cannot be tuned, by its author or

### 3.4 Provenance and the derived-segment discipline

⛔ **THE MASTERS STAY MASTERS.** `H:` and `D:` are **read-only** for the whole of
Gate 4. Nothing is moved, renamed, resampled, normalised or written there, ever.

Gate 4 material is **derived copies**, written only under
`decoder-bench\gate4_corpus\`:

- **Short phrases are BIT-EXACT COPIES.** No resampling, no normalisation, no
  trimming. 48 kHz / 32-bit float / mono is preserved end to end.
- **Monologue rungs are cuts with recorded start and end sample offsets.**
- ⛔ **Resampling NEVER happens at corpus build time.** It happens inside the
  measurement, per arm, through the one declared resampler of §4, and is
  recorded on the row.

`GATE4_CORPUS.json`, frozen before Stage 1:

- for every segment: **speaker · sex · state · language · source master absolute
  path · microphone where applicable · start and end sample offsets · duration ·
  sample rate · subtype · channels**
- **sha256 of the source master file AND sha256 of the derived copy**
- the transcript string, and its source file, for segments carrying one
- the exact selection-rule execution log, including every excluded index with
  its measured duration and reason
- ⛔ **The corpus is never re-drawn.** An unreadable file becomes a recorded
  `EXCLUDED — UNREADABLE` row; it is not quietly swapped.

### 3.5 ⛔ SOURCE-ONLY SCREENS — BOTH ARE GONE (D14)

⚠️ **This section previously read "Two SOURCE-ONLY screens… Both use only original recordings". THERE ARE ZERO.** §3.5.1 is **`NOT MEASURED`** (the control was null by construction, B2) and §3.5.2 was **WITHDRAWN** on owner review. Both are retained below as history; **neither runs, and neither gates anything.**

⛔ **NEITHER SCREEN RUNS.** The text below records what each was, why it was
abandoned, and what is carried in its place.

**3.5.1 The denoise control.** The corpus is the **spectrally denoised** copy.
Denoising removes the low-level noise floor, and reproducing a natural noise
floor is something neural codecs are measurably poor at — so every fidelity
number here will be **slightly optimistic relative to raw audio, and says so**.

⚠️ **The specific risk is WHISPER, because whisper is noise-like by nature and a
spectral denoiser can attenuate whispered speech itself.** If that happened,
whisper results would measure the denoiser rather than the codec.

> ⛔ **THIS CONTROL IS `NOT MEASURED`, AND THE REASON IS A DEFECT IN ITS OWN
> DESIGN (B2).**
>
> As written it compared "the `H:` denoised copy against the `D:` pre-denoise
> master". **`D:` IS NOT A PRE-DENOISE MASTER.** §3.0 measured `D:` to be
> identical to `<PRIVATE_DENOISED_TREE>` on every file compared. The
> control therefore compared **two copies of the same processing stage**, and was
> **guaranteed to return zero and to "dismiss" the whisper-denoise concern for
> the wrong reason.** A control that cannot fail is not a control (R1).
>
> **Disposition: `NOT MEASURED`.** The only un-denoised tree is
> `<PRIVATE_ORIGINAL_TREE>`, and reading it would reopen the dataset archaeology
> this document has closed. **The concern is therefore carried as a DECLARED,
> UNQUANTIFIED scope limit, not as a measured and dismissed one:**
>
> > **The Gate 4 source is denoised, trimmed and peak-ceilinged. What that
> > processing did to whispered phonation specifically is `NOT MEASURED`. No
> > Gate 4 output may state that the processing left whisper intact, and no
> > whisper result may be read as a property of unprocessed whispered speech.**
>
> ⚠️ This is weaker than a measurement and is labelled as weaker. It is not
> repaired by looking harder at other trees.

**3.5.2 Source acoustics are DESCRIPTIVE. There is no admissibility screen.**

⛔ **WITHDRAWN 2026-09-12, before any Gate 4 number existed: an earlier draft of
this section proposed a "whisper admissibility screen" that could have excluded
speakers from the whisper condition on source acoustics.** It was rejected on
owner review and the rejection is recorded rather than quietly dropped. Three
defects, each independently sufficient:

1. **The criterion was naive.** It treated voicing as a clean binary — *"near-zero
   voicing = true whisper, detectable pitch = breathy voice"*. Whispered
   phonation is not binary, and **F0 detectors produce spurious voicing on
   precisely the noisy, breathy material the screen would have judged.** The
   instrument would have been least reliable exactly where it was decisive.
2. **It rested on an unestablished hypothesis.** *"Level predicts denoise
   damage"* is a plausible mechanism that **has not been measured on these
   recordings**. Writing it into a gate is the R13 defect this document bans by
   name in §11.11.
3. ⭐ **It was out of scope.** **Gate 4 measures what the decoders do to the
   recordings that exist.** It does not require a speaker to have produced a
   textbook physiological whisper before their recording becomes admissible.
   The screen would have **discarded real evidence** to satisfy a criterion this
   study invented for itself.

> **THE RULE, frozen:**
>
> **All 7 speakers. All 6 labelled states. All 7 whisper sets. No speaker is
> excluded from any state on the basis of how they performed it.**
>
> **Source acoustics — level, harmonicity, spectral tilt — ARE measured and ARE
> reported, DESCRIPTIVELY, beside the results.** They characterise the material.
> ⛔ **They never decide admissibility, and no result is filtered by them.**
>
> **The state label is what it has always been: a stratification variable
> recording what the speaker was asked to perform.** It was never required to be
> perceptually or physiologically validated, and §5.4's reasoning is unchanged —
> every comparison is a recording against ITS OWN reconstruction.

⚠️ **Also withdrawn, same review: the claim that the five non-whisper states
"are ordinary phonation and will behave."** That is a prediction about
unmeasured quantities. `PROTOCOL.md` §5 states that nothing is predicted in this
study. **No state is assumed easy, and no state is assumed hard.**

**`pan` is an ANCHOR CASE only** — the speaker held fixed wherever a single
speaker is required, on the basis of corpus depth (16 921 files, 12 language
folders, MEASURED). ⛔ **Anchor status confers nothing on any measurement and
never narrows a condition to one speaker.**

⛔ **Nothing is copied until the owner has read this section.**

## 4. References, resampling, and the two unforced denominators (R18)

Every arm has its own input rate `sr_in` and output rate `sr_out`. There is no
single correct way to compare a 16 kHz decoder with a 44.1 kHz decoder, so
**both candidate denominators are computed and reported side by side, and the
choice is called unforced**, per `PROTOCOL.md` §13 / R18.

**One master, one resampler, applied identically everywhere:**
`torchaudio.functional.resample`, parameters declared in
`gate4_lib.py::RESAMPLE` and recorded on every row. Both sides of every
comparison come from the same master through the same resampler, so resampler
damage is common-mode and declared rather than hidden.

```
corpus master (≥ 44.1 kHz, mono, float32)
  ├─ → arm.sr_in  → encode → decode → arm output @ arm.sr_out
  ├─ → arm.sr_out                     = REFERENCE-NATIVE   (denominator 1)
  └─ → 16 000 Hz                      = REFERENCE-COMMON   (denominator 2)
                                        arm output also → 16 000 Hz
```

| denominator | what it measures | what it flatters / penalises |
|---|---|---|
| **REFERENCE-NATIVE** — each arm against the source resampled to that arm's own output rate | *"how faithfully did this route reproduce what it is capable of representing"* | flatters a narrowband arm: a 16 kHz arm is never asked about 8–22 kHz |
| **REFERENCE-COMMON** — every arm and every reference resampled to 16 kHz | *"how faithfully did this route reproduce the band every arm shares"* | discards real bandwidth that a 44.1 kHz arm genuinely delivers |

⛔ **Neither is the true one. Both are reported for every source-referenced cell,
in the same table, and no headline sentence uses one without naming it.**

**Mono.** The product target is mono (`PROTOCOL.md` §1 / handoff §1). Multi-
channel corpus files are mixed to mono by mean before anything else, and the
channel count is a §8 predicate on the output.

## 5. Metrics — declared domains, written before use

**R19 governs this section: declare the domain, never enumerate the failures.
Every metric below states what it is defined over and what makes an input
inadmissible. None of them is trusted until §6's fuzz suite has run.**

⚠️ **The controlling precedent is amendment 6.** A one-sample shift on
`encodec24_q8` scored **34.07%** on the chunking metric — inside the band that
metric reported for genuine chunking damage — and an all-zero output scored
exactly **100.00%**, better than a four-sample shift. **A metric that cannot tell
misalignment from damage is a DETECTOR and may never carry a ranking.** Gate 4
assumes every metric is a detector until the fuzz suite shows otherwise.

### 5.1 Metrics are tiered by their ALIGNMENT REQUIREMENT, not by convention

| tier | alignment requirement | admissible against |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | aligned **by construction** at sample 0 | **only** streamed output vs that same arm's own full-context decode (Q1, Q3-streamed) |
| **B** | frame alignment after a **declared, measured, correlation-gated** delay compensation | the source, **only when the alignment gate passes for that (arm, utterance)** |
| **C** | **alignment-free** — the statistic is invariant to a time shift | the source, always |

⛔ **Tier A metrics are NEVER computed against the source.** Neural codecs do not
preserve phase; a waveform-domain distance between a codec output and the source
measures phase, not quality, and would produce a confident wrong ranking.

⛔ **Any cross-arm statement about source fidelity rests on TIER C**, unless the
tier-B alignment gate passed for **both** arms on **the same** utterances, in
which case tier B may be used and the passing utterance count is printed beside
the number.

### 5.2 Tier A — within-arm only

| metric | definition | declared domain | inadmissible when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_abs_err` / `rel_pct` | **`gate_lib.err()`, imported verbatim** — `max|full − streamed|` over the common prefix, and that over the reference's own peak | both signals finite, non-empty, same arm, same tokens | either signal fails §8 · lengths differ by more than the arm's `per_chunk_offset_samples` accounts for |
| `si_sdr` | scale-invariant SDR of streamed against the arm's own full decode, dB (the implementation is `gate4_lib.si_sdr`; an earlier draft called it `si_sdr_self`) | reference non-zero, both finite, **equal length** | reference RMS = 0 · lengths unequal · either fails §8 |
| `seam_jump_ratio`, `local_diff_rms_norm` | **`gate3_lib.seam_metrics()`, imported verbatim** — §10.6, frozen before any output was heard | ≥ 1 seam, window ≥ 4 samples at the arm's own SR | fewer than 1 usable seam |

**These three already exist, already ran in Gate 3, and are reused unchanged.**
Gate 4 extends them from the frozen probe to the real corpus and to the E3
condition. **Their claim boundary is unchanged: they compare a decoder against
ITSELF and are not a quality ranking between decoders.**

### 5.3 Tier B — source-referenced, alignment-gated

| metric | definition | gain (M5) | inadmissible when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mcd` | mel-cepstral distortion, 24 cepstra **excluding c0**, window **25 ms** / hop **5 ms** declared in PHYSICAL TIME, mel band **0–8 000 Hz** declared in PHYSICAL FREQUENCY | ✅ **gain-invariant** by construction (c0 dropped) | alignment gate FAIL · shorter than one window · length mismatch |
| `lsd` | log-spectral distance over STFT magnitude, window **25 ms** / hop **5 ms** | ⚠️ **gain-SENSITIVE** — ×2 gain moves it exactly 20·log₁₀2 = 6.02 dB. **Only the `gain_matched` variant may rank.** | as above |
| `mrstft_mag` | multi-resolution STFT magnitude distance at **10 / 25 / 50 ms** | ⚠️ **gain-SENSITIVE, and SATURATES at 1.0** — an all-zero estimate and a ×2 gain both score ≈1.0, so poor arms become unorderable. **Only the `gain_matched` variant may rank, and the saturation point is printed on every row.** | as above |

#### ⭐ M2 — analysis geometry is declared in PHYSICAL UNITS, not sample counts

**The defect:** `lsd`, `mrstft_mag` and `ltas_dist` used **fixed sample counts**,
so `lsd` was a **64.0 ms** window at 16 kHz and **21.3 ms** at 48 kHz, with
frequency bins 15.6 Hz and 46.9 Hz wide. `mcd`'s `n_fft` rounded to a power of
two, so a declared "25 ms" was actually 32.0 ms at 16 kHz, 42.7 ms at 24/48 kHz
and 46.4 ms at 22.05/44.1 kHz — **the declared window was never the actual
window.** §5.3's safeguard ("identical for every arm at a given denominator") is
**vacuous where the denominator is per-arm**, which REFERENCE-NATIVE is.

> **Every window and hop is now an exact sample count for a declared
> MILLISECOND duration; the FFT is zero-padded to a power of two for efficiency
> only, which does not change the analysis window. The mel filterbank spans a
> declared HERTZ range.**
>
> ⛔ **CONSEQUENCE, and it narrows a claim:** under **REFERENCE-NATIVE** each arm
> is analysed at its own rate over its own band, so **REFERENCE-NATIVE IS A
> WITHIN-ARM DENOMINATOR AND CARRIES NO CROSS-ARM RANKING.** Every cross-arm
> tier-B statement uses **REFERENCE-COMMON**, where all signals sit at 16 kHz and
> the mel band is 0–8 000 Hz for every arm — the only condition under which the
> comparison is like-for-like.

#### ⭐ M3 — the log floor is RELATIVE and BOUNDED

**The defect:** `+1e-10` inside the log made an empty band an **unbounded**
distance. Measured: `mcd` scored an 8 kHz band-limit of the **same utterance** at
**2 847.5** — **2.6× worse than digital silence** and 3.1× worse than a different
speaker. `ltas_dist` scored it 72.85 against 9.50 for a different speaker.
**Wherever a decoder rolls off inside its own band, those metrics were measuring
spectral SUPPORT, not fidelity.**

> **Both spectra are now floored at `SPEC_FLOOR_DB = −80 dB` RELATIVE TO THE
> REFERENCE'S OWN PEAK.** A band with no energy is a large but **finite**
> distance. Band-limiting is still detected; it no longer dominates.

#### ⭐ M5 — the level convention is declared once, for every metric

> **Gate 4 measures at PRESERVED ABSOLUTE LEVEL. No level normalisation is
> applied to any signal at any point** — a decoder that changes level has a
> defect, and hiding it would be wrong.
>
> **But a gain-sensitive metric cannot separate a level error from a spectral
> one.** So every gain-sensitive metric is computed **BOTH ways — raw and after a
> declared least-squares scalar gain match — and BOTH are reported.**
> ⛔ **Only the gain-matched variant may carry a ranking.** The raw variant is a
> detector for level error and is reported as such.
> **No metric silently assumes one convention while another assumes the other.**

### ⛔ B7 — THE RAW-WAVEFORM ALIGNMENT GATE IS WITHDRAWN

**What it was:** per `(arm, utterance)`, cross-correlate the **raw waveforms**
via `gate3_lib.estimate_delay()` and require
`normalised_peak_correlation ≥ 0.50`.

**Why it was invalid, MEASURED against the frozen `gate3_matrix.json`:** that
gate rejects **8 of 19 arms**, and not at random —

| arm | r | verdict under the withdrawn gate |
|---|---|---|
| `focalcodec_50hz` | 0.0827 | ⛔ rejected |
| `focalcodec_25hz` | 0.0988 | ⛔ rejected |
| `focalcodec_50hz_4k_causal` | 0.1062 | ⛔ rejected |
| `focalcodec_50hz_2k_causal` | 0.1176 | ⛔ rejected |
| `focalcodec_50hz_65k_causal` | 0.1509 | ⛔ rejected |
| `focalcodec_12_5hz` | 0.1972 | ⛔ rejected |
| `vocos_mel24` | 0.2587 | ⛔ rejected |
| `griffinlim` | 0.3639 | ⛔ rejected |
| ⭐ `mimi_q8` — **PRIMARY** | **0.5132** | survives by **2.6%** |

⛔ **Those are precisely the architectures that RESYNTHESISE PHASE**, and §5.1 of
this document already states that neural codecs do not preserve phase. **The
gate was measuring phase coherence and calling it alignability.** Its missingness
would have been *correlated with the estimand*: tier-B metrics unavailable for
exactly the arms whose spectral fidelity is the question, **Route B left with no
valid tier-B pair at all**, and Q9's floor never receiving a tier-B number.
§5.3 previously cited `r = 0.08 – 0.19` as the gate's *justification* without
noticing it **predicted mass failure**.

### ⭐ The replacement: ENVELOPE alignment, phase-invariant

> **`gate4_lib.alignment()`** cross-correlates the **short-time RMS energy
> envelope** (20 ms window, 5 ms hop, declared in physical time), not the
> waveform. A decoder may reconstruct with entirely different phase and still
> place the same energy at the same instants — that is a faithful reconstruction,
> and the gate must not reject it.
>
> **Gate: `envelope_correlation ≥ 0.50`**, ±250 ms search.
> Below it the row is **`ALIGNMENT NOT ESTABLISHED`**, no tier-B metric is
> computed, and **the count of unjudged rows is printed in the same object as
> every tier-B aggregate** (R18 corollary).

⚠️ **`0.50` remains a DECLARED THRESHOLD, not a measured constant**, and is now
attackable against a fuzz that exercises it.

⭐ **VALIDATED WITHOUT RUNNING ANY DECODER.** `fuzz_gate4_lib.py::fuzz_alignment`
constructs the failure mode directly: a signal carrying the reference's **exact
magnitude spectrum with randomised phase**, at **known imposed delays**. A
correct aligner recovers the delay and admits the signal. The **withdrawn
raw-waveform method is run on the same material in the same report**, so the
repair is demonstrated rather than asserted.

⛔ **Gate 3's per-arm `delay_calibration` values are NOT reused as corrections.**
They were measured on the probe with `reliable: false`. They appear above only as
**evidence about the withdrawn gate**, never as a correction applied to anything.

### 5.4 Tier C — alignment-free, the backbone of any cross-arm statement

| metric | definition | declared domain | inadmissible when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spk_cos[<encoder>]` | cosine similarity between utterance-level pooled speaker embeddings of decoded and source audio, **one column per encoder, never averaged across encoders** | signal ≥ the encoder's declared minimum duration; both resampled to the encoder's own declared input rate by the one declared resampler | signal shorter than the encoder's minimum |
| `wer`, `cer` | ASR word/character error rate against the corpus's verbatim transcript, one declared ASR model + version + greedy decoding + a declared text-normalisation function | a transcript exists; signal ≥ 0.5 s | no transcript · ASR returns empty on the **source** (that utterance is excluded from Q6 for every arm alike, and the count is printed) |
| `ltas_dist` | distance between long-term average spectra, decoded vs source, in dB, at the declared denominator | signal ≥ 1 s | shorter than 1 s |
| `bandwidth_kHz` | highest frequency holding ≥ a declared fraction of band energy | signal ≥ 1 s | shorter than 1 s |

**`bandwidth_kHz` is a sanity instrument, not a quality score.** It exists so
that a 16 kHz arm scoring well under REFERENCE-COMMON cannot be silently read as
a 44.1 kHz-quality result.

#### 5.4.1 The speaker-encoder rule — the estate has already measured this

⚠️ **A speaker-similarity number is a property of the encoder as much as of the
audio.** This estate's own 14-encoder benchmark measured encoders disagreeing
with each other on the same audio. Therefore:

- **≥ 3 speaker encoders**, spanning families the frozen encoder study found to
  disagree. **Every result is per encoder. They are never averaged, never
  reduced to "speaker similarity", and a claim that holds on one encoder and not
  another is reported as exactly that.**
- **The exact encoder set is named at freeze time by reading the frozen encoder
  study's own artifact.** ⚠️ *That study was not opened in the thread that wrote
  this file, and no figure from it is quoted here.*
- ⭐ **The calibration control is mandatory and is computed on the SOURCE
  audio alone, before any decoded audio is scored:** the within-speaker cosine
  between two *different* source utterances of the same speaker (the natural
  ceiling), and the between-speaker cosine across the selected speakers (the
  floor). **A codec's cosine is reported only against that measured ceiling and
  floor.** An uncalibrated cosine has no scale and none is reported.

#### 5.4.2 The ASR rule

- **The source floor is measured, never assumed.** Q6 is `WER(decoded) −
  WER(source)` at the same band. An ASR that misreads the source misreads the
  decode too, and only the delta is a property of the route.
- **Every signal is resampled to 16 kHz for ASR**, by the one declared
  resampler, because that is the ASR's own input rate. **This makes Q6 a
  band-limited comparison for every arm, and that is stated on the table.**
- Model, revision, decoding strategy, language, seed and the text-normalisation
  function are all pinned in `GATE4_PREREG_FROZEN.json` before Stage 2 runs.

### 5.4.3 ⭐ WHAT SURVIVED — and how narrow the ranking basis actually is

⛔ **MEASURED, not chosen: of 9 metric variants implemented and attacked, ONE
carries a ranking.**

| may RANK | may only DETECT |
|---|---|
| `mcd` — passes G1–G7 in **all six states** | `lsd` · `lsd_gainmatched` · `mrstft_mag` · `mrstft_gainmatched` · `ltas_dist` · **`ltas_gainmatched`** · `si_sdr` · `max_abs_err` · `seams` · `bandwidth_khz` |

**A detector may report THAT two signals differ. It may NEVER report that one
decoder is better than another, in any output format.** Detectors are still
computed and reported — they carry `NOT COMPARABLE` as a first-class state, and
several of them are the only evidence available for arms where `mcd` is
inadmissible.

⚠️ **This is a thin basis and it is declared as one.** If `mcd` proves
inadmissible for an arm — alignment gate failure, length failure, or a §8
failure upstream — **that arm receives NO ranking at all**, and the absence is
displayed as an absence.

⚠️ **`mcd` is gain-INVARIANT by construction (c0 excluded), which means Gate 4's
only ranking metric is BLIND TO A PURE LEVEL ERROR.** A decoder that reproduces
the spectral envelope perfectly at the wrong level scores perfectly on `mcd`.
**Level error is therefore reported separately by the gain-sensitive detectors
(`lsd`, `ltas_dist` raw), and a `mcd` ranking never implies level fidelity.**

### 5.5 ⛔ Explicitly NOT in Gate 4

| excluded | reason |
|---|---|
| PESQ, ViSQOL, POLQA, DNSMOS, UTMOS, NISQA and every MOS-predictor | they are **proxies for perception**. The handoff puts perception in a later phase with its own pre-registration. Admitting a MOS predictor here would let a perceptual claim enter through an objective-sounding door. |
| any listening test | later phase |
| Detectorproof / adversarial detectability | later phase |
| voice **cloning** quality | cloning requires a generator; generator behaviour is outside this study (§2). **Speaker-identity RETENTION through the round trip (Q5) is in scope; cloning is not.** |
| bf16 / fp16 quality | fp32 is the Phase 1 comparability baseline (§6, §16.2.3). A separate precision gate is required before any build decision. |

## 6. ⛔ The instrument is fuzzed BEFORE it is trusted (R19)

**`fuzz_gate4_lib.py` runs and its report is written BEFORE a single quality
number is computed on real material.** No metric is used until it appears in
`fuzz_gate4_lib.json` with its tier confirmed.

**Declare the domain, never enumerate the failures.** The attacks below are not a
list of the ways a metric can break — they are probes of the declared domain, and
the report says *"survived N attacks"*, never *"closed"*.

⚠️ **M1 — THE DAMAGE LADDER IS ONE DAMAGE CLASS, AND THAT LIMITS WHAT
MONOTONICITY LICENSES.** The ladder is **additive white Gaussian noise**.
Monotonicity under AWGN does **not** by itself establish monotonicity under
quantisation, band-limiting or phase incoherence — which are the damage classes
a codec actually produces. **The fuzz therefore also probes band-limiting and
phase destruction, and records each metric's response, but those are recorded
properties rather than additional monotonic ladders.**

> **DECLARED LIMIT: a `SEVERITY SCALE` verdict means "monotonic in additive
> noise, shift-tolerant, length-sensitive and not fooled by silence". It does
> NOT mean "monotonic in every damage a codec can produce."** No Gate 4 output
> may claim otherwise, and this sentence travels with every ranking.

Every metric is probed against a reference signal with, at minimum:

| probe | what it establishes |
|---|---|
| the identical signal | the metric's exact no-damage value. A metric that does not return its declared identity value on identical input is **broken and is removed**, not adjusted. |
| **shifted by 1 sample** | ⭐ **the tier test.** If the 1-sample response is comparable to the response to genuine degradation, the metric is **demoted to DETECTOR** and may not carry a ranking. This is amendment 6, generalised. |
| shifted by 4, 16, 256 samples | shift sensitivity curve, recorded |
| scaled by ×0.5 and ×2.0 | scale sensitivity; distinguishes a gain error from damage |
| all-zero output | must **not** score better than a mildly damaged signal (the amendment-6 failure) |
| NaN / inf injected | must return `UNKNOWN`, never a number |
| truncated by one hop, and by 256 samples | the `vocos_mel24` / `griffinlim` `b = −256` signature must be **detected as a length failure**, never absorbed into a quality score |
| a **different utterance entirely** | ⚠️ **DESCRIPTIVE ONLY.** The requirement that every real value sit below this bound was the **WITHDRAWN condition 4** (§6.2.1), and it is measurably violated by `lsd` (15.09 vs 30.48) and `ltas_dist` (7.01 vs 26.10) — which is why it is not a requirement. |
| the same utterance from a **different speaker** | for `spk_cos`, the between-speaker floor |
| band-limited to 8 kHz | for `ltas_dist` / `bandwidth_kHz`, the narrowband signature |
| ⛔ ~~resampled round trip with no codec~~ | **DELETED (B4 / D2).** The 48→24→48 probe band-limited the estimate to 12 kHz while leaving the reference full-band — **a chain §4 never performs**, because §4 always brings both sides to the same rate. It produced thresholds larger than the distance to a different person's voice. The floor that licenses a ranking is now the **measured INSTRUMENT FLOOR** of §6.1.2. |
| **phase destruction at a known delay** | ⭐ **the instrument floor.** Per-frame phase randomisation with overlap-add, then a known delay — what a neural decoder actually produces. What the alignment residual costs `mcd` here IS the floor. |

### 6.1 ⭐ THE FUZZ — RE-RUN AT THE RANKING RATE, 2026-09-12 (delta repair)

⛔ **D1. THE SUITE NOW RUNS AT 16 kHz — THE RATE AT WHICH RANKING ACTUALLY
HAPPENS.** The previous run was at 48 kHz only, and certified `mcd`

**Delay resolution is now ONE SAMPLE**, refined inside ±1 envelope hop using the
same phase-invariant RMS envelope evaluated at every sample.

one 5 ms hop**. Measured on the previous code, charged to `mcd`:
**sr=16k true 40 → reported 0 → 49% of a damage rung; sr=48k true 120 →
reported 0 → 82%.** The fuzz could not see it because its tolerance was set
**equal to its own quantum**, so `delayed_100 → 0` was recorded as recovered.

### 6.1.2 ⭐ THE INSTRUMENT FLOOR — F2: A DISTRIBUTION, PER STATE, NOT ONE DRAW

⛔ **THE PREVIOUS FLOOR (`mcd` 23.88, 9.09% of a rung) WAS A SINGLE FAVOURABLE
PHASE DRAW, AND IT WAS NOT STABLE.** Re-running the identical construction with
other deterministic draws on the same file and state gave **38.62 / 56.93 /
85.80** — every one higher. Across three states, **7 of 9 draws exceeded the
declared value.** A difference sitting inside the apparatus's own alignment noise
would have been reported as decoder-attributable.

**THE CONSTRUCTION, frozen before any decoder output exists:**
**N = 16 deterministic phase draws × all 6 states**, delays
`(7, 40, 100, 333, 1000)` samples, the **production alignment path**, **held-out
calibration recordings only**, **no decoder**. The floor is the
**0.95 quantile** of the residual-cost distribution **in that
state**. Seed, draw count, delays and quantile are all fixed in
`fuzz_gate4_lib.py` and were set before the distribution was seen.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Neutral | 257.6 | 16 | 0.0255 | 0.3740 | **0.3691** | **95.08** |
| Angry | 144.6 | 16 | 0.0398 | 0.6325 | **0.4660** | **67.39** |
| Happy | 240.1 | 16 | 0.0543 | 0.3532 | **0.3416** | **81.99** |
| Scared | 146.7 | 16 | 0.0000 | 0.8236 | **0.7163** | **105.1** |
| Shouting | 255.2 | 16 | 0.0315 | 0.3478 | **0.3154** | **80.51** |
| Whisper | 86.7 | 16 | 0.0330 | 1.0004 | **0.9753** | **84.59** |

⭐ **THE FLOOR IS STATE-AWARE, AND IT HAD TO BE.** It ranges from
**0.32** of a damage rung on Shouting to
**0.98 on WHISPER** — where the apparatus's own alignment residual costs
**nearly as much as the mildest damage it can detect**. The single-draw figure
understated it by **10.7×** at worst.

⚠️ **THE CONSEQUENCE, stated plainly: on whispered speech this apparatus can
barely separate decoder damage from its own alignment error at the mild end.**
A whisper ranking needs an effect approaching one full damage rung before it is
attributable. That is a real limit of the instrument and it is declared, not
worked around.

⛔ **§11.1 condition 5(b) uses the floor FOR THE STATE THE COMPARISON IS IN, in
ABSOLUTE `mcd` UNITS.** A **pooled** comparison uses the **MAXIMUM ABSOLUTE
floor** over contributing states — **105.07 (Scared)** over all six.

⛔ **M1: selecting the largest FRACTION is WRONG and is withdrawn.** Whisper has
the largest fraction (0.9753) but an absolute floor of 84.59; Scared requires
105.07. The fraction form is also undefined for a pooled set, because the
rung is per state and per calibration recording. **The floor is never averaged
across states, and an unrecognised state FAILS CLOSED.**

⛔ **`rate_chain_floor` remains retired** — it returns exactly 0.0 for 15 of 18
arms (D2).

### 6.1.3 ⭐ G6 — SPECTRAL SUPPORT, and why `ltas_gainmatched` was demoted (F1/F3)

**F3 found a real implementation defect in `ltas_dist` and it is repaired:** the
spectral floor was measured from the peak of the **full STFT** (24.39) and
applied to the **frame-averaged** spectrum (peak 2.65) — roughly 10× too hard,
clamping **127 of 257 bins (49.4%)** of a 4 kHz-limited estimate against 8 of 257
for the reference. `lsd` already used the consistent form; only `ltas_dist` had
the mismatch. **The floor is now taken and applied in the same domain.**

⛔ **THE REPAIR DID NOT RESCUE IT, AND IT WAS NOT SUPPOSED TO.** A new declared
gate now measures the property directly:

> **G6 — SPECTRAL SUPPORT. A band-limited version of the SAME utterance must
> score CLOSER than a DIFFERENT SPEAKER.** A metric that fails this is measuring
> how much band a decoder retained, not how faithful it was — and a narrowband
> but otherwise faithful decoder would rank below an unrelated voice.

**MEASURED at the ranking rate, as a percentage of the different-speaker
distance:**

| | 7 kHz | 6 kHz | 4 kHz | G6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mcd` (Whisper, worst state) | 23% | 59% | 80% | ✅ **PASS** |
| `ltas_gainmatched` (Angry) | **163%** | 261% | 378% | ⛔ **FAIL** |

**`ltas_gainmatched` fails at 7 kHz — the mildest roll-off tested — in 4 of 5
states.** A 7 kHz roll-off is entirely plausible for a real decoder. **Demoted.**

### ⛔ B1 — THE TWO STATED BACKSTOPS WERE FALSE, AND ARE STRUCK

The 4 kHz boundary was justified by two claims. **Both are false by
measurement, and both were MY assertions rather than measurements** — in a
document whose whole discipline is the opposite.

| claim | measured |
|---|---|
| *"`bandwidth_khz` reports gross narrowbanding directly"* | ⛔ **BLIND.** At `BANDWIDTH_FRACTION = 0.99` it reports **2.250 kHz for untouched audio and 2.250 kHz for a 4 kHz-limited copy** — identical across the entire gated range. Speech energy is so concentrated below 2 kHz that the 99% point is reached before any roll-off matters. |
| *"§8's energy predicate would catch it upstream"* | ⛔ **FALSE.** Energy retained after a 2 kHz roll-off: Whisper 0.9230 · Angry 0.9560 · Neutral 0.9777 · Happy 0.9868 · Shouting 0.9940 · Scared 0.9950, against `MIN_ENERGY_RATIO = 0.25`. A roll-off would have to destroy 75% of the energy to trip it. |

**And the Nyquist argument only fixes the UPPER end of the probe range.** Nothing
about arms whose Nyquist is ≥ 8 kHz implies a lower cut at 4 kHz; *"half the
common Nyquist"* is a round number, not a property of any arm.

**Both claims are struck from this section and from the code comment.**

### ⭐ THE REPLACEMENT — B1 FINAL: A **SOURCE-RELATIVE** SUPPORT DOMAIN

⛔ **THE FIRST REPLACEMENT WAS ALSO BROKEN, AND THE EXPLOIT IS RECORDED.**
`spectral_rolloff_hz(estimate, 0.9999) ≥ 2750 Hz` reads the **estimate alone**.
At 0.9999 the statistic is a function of the top 0.01% of the energy **tail**: it
detects whether *any* high-frequency energy **exists**, not whether the signal has
**support** there. It was calibrated only against ideal **brick-wall cuts** — the
one family in which that behaves like a bandwidth — and **real decoder output is
never a brick-wall cut.** Quantisation noise, dither, GAN hiss and iSTFT leakage
all place a low-level broadband floor exactly where it looked.

**MEASURED EXPLOIT, reproduced here** (Whisper / Speaker_06 / 0710, 2 kHz cut,
unrelated-speaker `mcd` = 984.1):

| estimate | `mcd` | G6 | OLD roll-off | OLD verdict | **NEW support** | **NEW verdict** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| plain 2 kHz cut | 1177.5 | FAIL | 2031 | excluded | 2000 | excluded |
| + 7 kHz sine −40 dBFS | 1247.0 | FAIL | 7094 | ⛔ **ADMITTED** | 2000 | ✅ excluded |
| + HF noise −40 dBFS | 1355.5 | FAIL | 8000 | ⛔ **ADMITTED** | 2000 | ✅ excluded |
| + 7 kHz sine −60 dBFS | 1171.6 | FAIL | 7031 | ⛔ **ADMITTED** | 2000 | ✅ excluded |
| + HF noise −60 dBFS | 1129.8 | FAIL | 7375 | ⛔ **ADMITTED** | 2000 | ✅ excluded |
| control, untouched | 0.0 | PASS | 7594 | admitted | 8000 | ✅ admitted |

**A component 60 dB below full scale converted an out-of-domain cell into an
in-domain one.** `focalcodec_50hz_2k_causal` is a 2 kbps arm in this study; a
band-limited output carrying a low-level noise floor is the characteristic
low-bitrate signature, not an exotic attack.

### THE LIVE PREDICATE — `gate4_support.validated_support()`

⛔ **THE FIRST SOURCE-RELATIVE VERSION WAS ALSO EXPLOITABLE, AND THAT IS RECORDED
TOO.** It tested `retention(b) >= RETENTION_MIN` only. **Retention had no upper
bound**, so ratios of 10, 100 or 1000 counted as "supported" — energy the source
never had still satisfied the predicate. Structurally the same flaw as the
retired roll-off statistic, merely requiring a louder addition.

**MEASURED EXPLOIT:** a **250 Hz-spaced sine comb bridging 2–6 kHz** on a
2 kHz-limited signal reached `supported_up_to = 6000` with **total energy within
1.8% of the source** — so §8's energy predicate saw nothing — while `mcd`'s G6
ordering was broken. Broadband noise reached 8000. **15 cells were admitted.**
The calibration could not see it because its only noise tail started at 5 kHz,
leaving **2–5 kHz — exactly where contiguity bites — never bridged**, and there
was **no tonal probe at all**. A comb is not exotic: sparse harmonic
reconstruction, codebook *birdies* and GAN periodicity are named failure modes of
the low-bitrate arms here, and `focalcodec_50hz_2k_causal` is a 2 kbps arm.

### ⭐ THE REPAIRED PREDICATE — two-sided, level-matched

> **1. LEVEL-MATCH FIRST.** The estimate is matched to the source with
> `gate4_lib.gain_match` (phase-robust RMS) **before** retention is computed.
>
> **2. RETENTION IS BOUNDED ON BOTH SIDES:**
> **`retention_min ≤ retention(b) ≤ retention_max`.**
> Too *little* energy means the band was lost; too *much* means the estimate
> **invented** it. **Both break the contiguous run.**
>
> ```
> retention(b) = P_gain_matched_estimate(b) / P_source(b)     [250 Hz bands]
> supported_up_to_hz = upper edge of the longest CONTIGUOUS run from 0 Hz
>                      with retention_min <= retention <= retention_max
> DOMAIN: supported_up_to_hz >= support_min_hz
> ```

**CALIBRATED CONSTANTS — `retention_min = 0.05` ·
`retention_max = 1.25` · `support_min_hz = 4500`**

⭐ **ALL THREE ARE IDENTIFIED BY THE DATA.** Exactly **1** setting
achieves maximum coverage with zero false admissions — no tie-break was needed.
⚠️ **This is a change from the previous calibration, where `retention_min` was
NOT identified** (0.01–0.25 all gave identical counts) and the prereg wrongly
presented it as data-determined. **And `4500 Hz IS the lowest threshold in the
grid achieving zero false admissions — not a conservative step above it.**

| | measured |
|---|---|
| calibration population | **126 recordings** — 7 speakers × 3 held-out indices × 6 states |
| probe cells | **7938** (63 probes per recording) |
| **admitted** | **1603** |
| **false admissions** | ⭐ **0** |
| excluded | 6335 |
| conservative loss | 4325 |
| zero-FA grid points | 50 of 360 |

### ⭐ THE LEVEL CLIFF IS GONE

`mcd`'s gain invariance is **7e-13**, yet the previous predicate excluded on
level, **off a cliff**: MEASURED ×0.5 → support 8000 (admitted, retention landing
exactly on 0.25) while **×0.49 → support 0.0 (excluded)**. An arm with a
systematic level offset beyond 6.02 dB would have been **voided corpus-wide for a
reason the ranking metric does not measure.** The old calibration probed only
×0.5 and ×2 — the two points that pass — so the cliff was never sampled.

| gain | ×0.25 | ×0.49 | ×0.5 | ×1 | ×2 | ×4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| support | 8000 | 8000 | 8000 | 8000 | 8000 | 8000 |
| verdict | ADMIT | ADMIT | ADMIT | ADMIT | ADMIT | ADMIT |

**100% admitted at every level, all 126 recordings each.**

**Fail-closed behaviour verified:** digital silence → `NOT COMPARABLE — OUTSIDE
VALIDATED SUPPORT`; an uncalibrated config → the same; control → `MEASURED`.
⚠️ **Near-silence (×1e-3) is ADMITTED by this predicate and that is correct** —
after level matching it is identical to the source, and `mcd` is gain-invariant.
It never reaches a metric in production because **§8's energy predicate excludes
it upstream** (RMS ratio 1e-3 against `MIN_ENERGY_RATIO = 0.25`). **The support
predicate is not the energy gate and does not duplicate it.**

⛔ **SCOPE, unchanged and still the binding limit:** **zero false admissions over
the probed calibration family** — **NOT** a population false-admission rate,
which is **not established**. The 7938 cells are perturbations of
**126 recordings**; the independent unit is the RECORDING. Two probe families
have now each defeated a predicate that looked sound against the previous
family — **the correct reading is that the family is the limit of the claim.**

### 6.1.5 ⭐ ACCEPTED LIMITATIONS AT FINAL FREEZE — carried, not repaired

**Independent adversarial verification returned `BLOCKING: None · MAJOR: None ·
READY TO FREEZE: YES`.** Two MINOR limitations are accepted and travel with every
Gate 4 output. Neither affects admissibility; neither is a reason to reopen the
apparatus.

**1. The 250 Hz support band has a resolution floor.** `retention(b)` is computed
over 250 Hz bands from an STFT with finite leakage, so **the predicate cannot
resolve a spectral loss narrower than its effective leakage/resolution width.** A
notch much narrower than a band is averaged with its neighbours and may not break
the contiguous run. **Declared: the support domain certifies band-scale support,
not fine spectral structure.**

**2. Stage 2's support-before-ranking wiring is a PREREGISTERED CONTRACT, not yet
mechanically verified.** §11.2.5(c) requires `validated_support()` to be
evaluated per cell *before* conditions (a) and (b). **`gate4_metrics.py` does not
exist**, so that ordering is currently a written rule rather than executed code.
⛔ **It MUST be mechanically verified when Stage 2 is implemented** — a test that
a cell failing the support domain cannot reach a state-level or pooled ranking by
any path.

⛔ **THE APPARATUS IS FROZEN FROM THIS POINT AND IS NOT MODIFIED DURING STAGE 1.**
A decoder performing badly is a RESULT, never a reason to reopen the method.

### 6.1.4 ⭐ DECLARED LIMITATIONS OF THE SURVIVING METRIC

**Every one of these is MEASURED, bounded, and travels with any `mcd` result.**

**1. Extreme attenuation.** `mcd` is exact (~7e-13) at ×0.5 / ×2 and ~6.6e-4 at
×0.01 / ×100 / ×1e4, but reads **3.73 at ×1e-4**, because `_cepstra`'s
proportional floor stops scaling once the relative term approaches the absolute
`EPS`. ⚠️ **CORRECTED: that 3.73 is NEUTRAL ONLY and does not generalise.** Measured
per state: Shouting 0.227 · Angry 0.710 · Scared 3.00 · Neutral 3.73 · Happy
12.39 · **Whisper 97.81** — which is **116% of Whisper's own floor and 145% of
the smallest declared floor.** A bound presented as general did not hold in the
worst state, in a document whose discipline is per-state gating.
⛔ **The CONCLUSION is unaffected, and unlike the G6 case §8 genuinely does
exclude this one:** a ×1e-4 output has an energy ratio of **1e-8** against
`MIN_ENERGY_RATIO = 0.25` — four orders of magnitude outside, not the 0.92–0.995
that made the G6 backstop false. Whisper sits ~21 dB below shouting in this
corpus, not 80 dB. **Declared rather than repaired, because repairing it would
move a floor no admissible input reaches.**

**2. Truncation inside tolerance.** Offline tolerances reach **±1 920 samples
(80 ms at 24 kHz)** for `mimi_q8`, `mimi_q32`, `qwen3_tts_tokenizer_12hz` and
`dualcodec_12hz_v1`. Within tolerance `_pair` truncates to the common length, so
up to that much can leave the comparison window.
> ⛔ **`length_delta` is recorded on every row and MUST be surfaced beside any
> ranking that uses such a cell.** A ranking whose cells carry a non-zero
> `length_delta` states it.

**3. `ltas_dist` delay sensitivity — repaired, now moot.** It took no delay
compensation, so a constant algorithmic delay shifted it one-directionally
(−0.4% of a rung at 5 ms, −5.3% at 80 ms, against Gate 3's measured arm delays of
15–36 ms ⇒ ~1–2.5%). **`delay_samples` is now applied.** The metric is a
DETECTOR after G6, so this carries no ranking — the repair stands so the detector
is not also wrong.

**4. The instrument floor is a MIXTURE over a probe ladder.** Its five delays
(7 / 40 / 100 / 333 / 1 000 samples) are pooled into one distribution per state,
and that is **not** the operational delay distribution — Gate 3's measured arm
delays are 15–36 ms (240–576 samples at 16 kHz), between the 100 and 333 probes.
Pooled medians by delay are 0.139 / 0.298 / 0.242 / 0.195 / 0.232: **no monotone
trend, so no evident bias** — but the floor inherits the mixture and says so.

**5. The 0.95 quantile at n = 16 is the second-largest draw.** In every state
exactly 1 of 16 draws exceeds the declared floor. Bootstrapping the quantile from
the 16 recorded fractions gives 95% CIs spanning 1.3×–2.2×. The direction is
conservative and the floors bound every independent counter-draw raised in
review, so nothing changes operationally — **but "0.95 quantile" should be read
as "the second-largest of 16 deterministic draws".**

**6. Probe accounting.** `attacks_run` **1064** vs `probes_consumed`
**954**. The difference is the **alignment probes and the
96 instrument-floor draws**, which feed the alignment verdict and the floor
distribution rather than a per-metric gate. **Every per-metric probe is consumed
by a gate or a recorded declared property** — `mcd` reports
`probes_consumed == probes_total`. `gain_x2.0` was previously collected per state
and read by nothing; **gate G7 now consumes it, and G7 now counts toward
`all_pass`** — it was computed and then excluded from the conjunction.

### 6.2 ⛔ PROCESS FAILURES BY THE AUTHOR — recorded, not deleted

**6.2.1** A post-hoc admissibility condition (unrelated-signal bound) was added
after seeing the first run and then **WITHDRAWN**; it tested the wrong property.

**6.2.2** The first unrelated bound was a block-scramble of the same recording —
too weak. Now a genuinely different speaker.

**6.2.3** The verdict consulted 3 of 20 probes; 102 of 120 measured attacks fed
nothing. **Repaired — 360 probes now consumed.**

**6.2.4 ⭐ D6 — `GAIN_REL_TOL = 0.01` WAS CHOSEN AFTER A RUN AND WAS NOT
DISCLOSED.** It decides whether Gate 4 has any ranking metric at all: under the
previous **absolute** `1e-9` tolerance, `mcd` was a DETECTOR and Gate 4 had
**zero** ranking metrics.

> **Why it is nonetheless correct, and why it is now disclosed rather than
> removed:** an absolute tolerance is meaningless across metrics whose values
> span three orders of magnitude. `mcd` drops c0 *precisely in order to be
> gain-invariant*, and its measured gain response was **5.5e-07** — float noise.
> Judging gain sensitivity **relative to each metric's own mildest-damage
> response** is the scale-free comparison. ⚠️ **It remains a threshold chosen
> after seeing a run, it is flagged as such, and a reviewer is invited to attack
> it.** After the D1 repair `mcd`'s gain response is **7e-13**, roughly
> **3e-13** of the tolerance — so the verdict no longer
> depends on where in that range the line sits.

**6.2.5** The phase-destruction probe was itself wrong — whole-signal
randomisation destroys the envelope. Replaced with per-frame randomisation.

⚠️ **All five are recorded because a reviewer must see that the instrument's own
rules changed during construction.** None reached a quality number, because none
exists.

⛔ **The author of this instrument is not its certifier.** The artifact says
**"survived 374 attacks"**; it never says *closed*.

## 7. Validity gates — an inadmissible signal has no quality

### 7.1 §8 output validity, reused verbatim

**`gate3_lib.validity()` is imported unchanged.** A quality number computed from
malformed output is inadmissible exactly as a timing number would be. A value
failing its predicate is treated as **absent**, and **absence is UNKNOWN, which
never becomes a pass** (R1).

**The energy predicate keeps its Gate 3 scoping, unchanged:** it **gates** on a
full-clip reconstruction (where output and source are aligned by construction)
and is **computed as a diagnostic only** on a prefix (where a decoder's constant
algorithmic delay makes the comparison invalid — the defect that drove a faithful
`focalcodec_50hz_4k_causal` prefix to a 0.198 energy ratio). **Which one applied
is recorded on every row.**

### 7.2 ⭐ The determinism gate — new in Gate 4, and it is not optional

**Timing tolerates a non-deterministic decoder; quality does not.** If a decoder
is not a function of its input, it has no defined quality number.

> **Before any quality cell runs for an arm, that arm decodes the same
> representation twice and the two outputs are compared with `gate_lib.err()`.
> The arm proceeds only if `max_abs_err == 0.0` exactly, or the arm declares a
> seeded stochastic stage whose seed is pinned and whose repeat error is then
> required to be `0.0` under that pin.** A non-zero residual is a **recorded
> `DETERMINISM NOT ESTABLISHED` row**, and that arm produces **no** quality
> number until it is resolved.

This is amendment 4 generalised. `griffinlim` with `rand_init=True` measured
self-vs-self at `7.7404e-01` (131.3% of peak) — a number that measured random
phase, not chunking, and was **WITHDRAWN**. The frozen configuration
(`rand_init=False`, measured `0.000e+00`) is carried in unchanged. `melflow`
draws flow noise once under a fixed seed shared by every condition, per
amendment 7, and that pin is carried in unchanged.

### 7.2.1 ⭐ THE LENGTH-TOLERANCE POLICY — D5, declared before any output exists

⛔ **`DEFAULT_LENGTH_TOL = 0` and `_pair()` raises correctly, but NO PER-ARM
TOLERANCE WAS DECLARED — while §8.3 simultaneously said the offline quality of
`vocos_mel24` and `griffinlim` "is fully admissible and is measured normally".**
Those are the two arms with a frozen `b = −256 samples/chunk`. Left as it was,
either every one of their tier-B/C cells becomes a `LENGTH FAILURE`, or a
tolerance gets chosen at Stage 2 **after outputs exist**. Neither is acceptable.

> **THE POLICY, derived ENTIRELY from frozen Gate 2 geometry — no Gate 4 output
> is consulted:**
>
> **OFFLINE (full-context):** tolerance = **that arm's own
> `samples_per_unit`** — one frame. Full-context decoding performs no chunking,
> so `b` cannot accumulate; the only admissible discrepancy is the arm's own
> frame quantisation.
>
> **STREAMED:** tolerance = **`n_chunks × |b| + samples_per_unit`**, with `b` =
> `per_chunk_offset_samples` read from `gate2_matrix.json` and `n_chunks` fixed
> by the condition. The drift is a **known, frozen, measured** property, not a
> discovered one.

| arm | `samples_per_unit` | frozen `b` | tolerance |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vocos_mel24` | 256.0 | -256.0 | OFFLINE ±256 · STREAMED n/a (E3 NOT ACHIEVABLE) |
| `griffinlim` | 256.0 | -256.0 | OFFLINE ±256 · STREAMED n/a (E3 NOT ACHIEVABLE) |
| `dualcodec_12hz_v1` | 1920.0 | -4.0 | OFFLINE ±1920 · STREAMED ±(n_chunks×4 + 1920) |
| `dualcodec_25hz_v1` | 960.0 | -4.0 | OFFLINE ±960 · STREAMED ±(n_chunks×4 + 960) |
| `mimi_q8` | 1920.0 | 0.0 | OFFLINE ±1920 · STREAMED ±(n_chunks×0 + 1920) |
| `encodec24_q8` | 320.0 | 0.0 | OFFLINE ±320 · STREAMED ±(n_chunks×0 + 320) |

⭐ **This RESOLVES the §8.3 collision.** `vocos_mel24` and `griffinlim` have
`E3 = NOT ACHIEVABLE`, so **they have no streamed cells at all**; their
**offline** cells sit inside a one-frame tolerance and are admissible exactly as
§8.3 says. The `b = −256` drift is a **streaming** property and never touches
their offline numbers.

⛔ **F4 — `melflow` HAS NO TOLERANCE, AND UNKNOWN STAYS UNKNOWN.**
`gate4_length_policy.offline_tolerance("melflow")` returns `None`: that arm has
**no `samples_per_unit` in the frozen Gate 2 matrix**, because its streaming
contract is frame-synchronous and no integer hop was ever recovered for it.

> **`length_tol=None` previously fell through to `DEFAULT_LENGTH_TOL = 0`,
> silently converting an UNMEASURED tolerance into an UNDECLARED EXACT-MATCH
> REQUIREMENT** — the exact silent-default class this study exists to remove
> (R1: a blank never means unknown, a zero never means unmeasured).
>
> **Repaired: `gate4_lib.TOL_NOT_ESTABLISHED` returns the state
> `NOT ESTABLISHED` and NO NUMBER. No tolerance is invented.**
>
> ⛔ **CONSEQUENCE: every `melflow` SOURCE-REFERENCED cell requiring a length
> tolerance is `NOT ADMISSIBLE`** until a hop is derived from frozen evidence.
> §9.2's statement that its offline quality is MEASURED is narrowed accordingly:
> the decode runs and is recorded, and the tier-B/C comparison against the source
> does not. Its **self-referential** (tier A) numbers are unaffected, because
> both sides come from the same decoder.

⛔ **Every tolerance above is computed from a frozen artifact by
`gate4_run.py` at Stage 1. None is typed, and none may be widened after an
output is seen.**

### 7.3 The admissibility ladder

Every Gate 4 cell carries exactly one of:

```
MEASURED                                    — §8 PASS, determinism PASS, metric in domain
ALIGNMENT NOT ESTABLISHED                   — tier B only, correlation gate failed
INADMISSIBLE — STREAMED OUTPUT FAILS §8     — computed, recorded, excluded from every aggregate
NOT ACHIEVABLE                              — no valid configuration exists (E3)
NOT ESTABLISHED                             — the path was never built or tested
NOT COMPARABLE                              — measured, valid, but may not share a table
BLOCKED — PLATFORM                          — nanocodec
DETERMINISM NOT ESTABLISHED                 — §7.2
```

⛔ **A blank never means unknown. A zero never means unmeasured** (R1). Every
field in every Gate 4 output carries its evidence state.

### 8.3 The two `NOT ACHIEVABLE` arms — what Gate 4 does with them

**`vocos_mel24` and `griffinlim` have no valid streaming configuration.** Quality
measured on their streamed output is the quality of an **inadmissible signal**.

> **Pre-committed:** their streamed cells **ARE computed and ARE recorded**
> (§12: every failure is a recorded row carrying its state, never a missing
> row), and every one of them carries
> **`INADMISSIBLE — STREAMED OUTPUT FAILS §8 duration_ok`**. They are excluded
> from every aggregate, every ranking and every cross-arm statement, and they are
> **never** reported as that arm's streaming quality.
>
> Their **offline** quality is fully admissible and is measured normally.

⛔ **This is not a licence to report the number and caveat it.** The number
exists in the raw artifact for audit; it does not appear in a results table
beside admissible numbers.

## 9. ⛔ The two hard constraints, and exactly how Gate 4 carries them

### 9.1 `fish_modified_dac` — cross-environment, converted from an assumption into a measurement

**Gate 3's E6 measured a 50.25% environment effect on TIMING**, and it is
**device-side**: at 2 s offline, host overhead is 0.022 vs 0.024 ms while CUDA
time is **10.344 vs 6.328 ms**. torch is identical (2.10.0+cu128) in every
environment; the two `transformers` versions **launch different GPU work for the
same decode**. ⚠️ **The direction must not be mis-stated: `fish` is FASTER** —
the incumbent's environment flatters it by ~3.5 ms per call. **Nothing says Fish
ModifiedDAC is fast or slow; it says its number and theirs cannot share a
ranking.**

**Different GPU work for the same decode raises a question timing cannot answer:
does it produce a different SIGNAL?** The handoff says the marker travels with
the arm and that if in doubt, the E6 control is run for the Gate 4 metric too.
**So it is run, first, and it is a gate.**

> **Q0 — the Gate 4 environment control.** `encodec24_q8` decodes the same
> byte-identical cached token tensor in `decbench` and in `fish`. Both outputs
> are persisted and hashed. Every Gate 4 metric is computed **between the two
> environments' waveforms**.
>
> - **If the two waveforms are bit-identical**, or differ by less than the
>   fuzz-suite's measured floor for each metric, then **quality is
>   cross-environment comparable, established by measurement**, and
>   `fish_modified_dac`'s quality numbers may enter a cross-arm table — carrying
>   a visible marker that says **this comparability was established for QUALITY
>   ONLY and that its TIMING remains `NOT COMPARABLE`**.
> - **If they differ materially**, `fish` is **`NOT COMPARABLE` for quality
>   too.** `fish_modified_dac` then reports only within its own environment, in
>   its own table, and is excluded from every cross-arm quality statement.
>
> ⭐ **M4 — THE Q0 THRESHOLD IS FIXED HERE, AND IT IS THE IDENTITY FLOOR.**
> An earlier draft said "resampler/identity floor", naming two quantities orders
> of magnitude apart (identity = 0; the deleted resampler reading = 1102.7 on
> `mcd`), which left the gate unfailable. **Q0 involves NO resampling at all** —
> it decodes byte-identical tokens in two environments at one rate — so the
> resampler reading was never the right quantity.
>
> **Q0 threshold: the IDENTITY floor. Every ranking metric returns exactly its
> identity value (0) on identical input, verified by fuzz gate G1. Q0 passes as
> COMPARABLE only if every metric returns its identity value to within float
> tolerance (1e-9).** Anything else is `NOT COMPARABLE`. Fixed before Q0 runs.

⚠️ **The `fish` environment is PRE-EXISTING and READ ONLY. It carries frozen
production work. Nothing is installed into it, ever.** Q0's `fish` side runs the
existing adapter (`gate3_arms_fish.py`) and writes WAV files out; **all metric
computation happens in Stage 2, outside `fish`.**

### 9.2 `melflow` — the scope limitation is carried, not quietly worked around

| what | Gate 4 disposition |
|---|---|
| **Offline / full-context quality** | ✅ **MEASURED.** The full-context path is established and its Gate Zero record PASSES. |
| **Streamed quality** | ⛔ **`NOT ESTABLISHED — NO STREAMING PCM PATH`.** Its label is `TRUE_INCREMENTAL — NEURAL DECODER; iSTFT STREAMING NOT ESTABLISHED`. §10.1 requires audio from partial input; MelFlow emits **spectrogram frames** and inverts **once** over the assembled spectrogram. |
| **Building an overlap-add stage** | ⛔ **OUT OF SCOPE for Gate 4.** It is new engineering, and R13 forbids upgrading a capability by inspection. A control already measured naive split-in-two iSTFT at **121.39% on GPU** (134.65% on CPU in the delta audit) — **the stage is not free.** If it is ever built, it is built, TESTED, and pre-registered separately before any number from it is reported. |
| **Counting** | ⛔ **Never counted with the three `TRUE_INCREMENTAL (representation → PCM)` arms.** The two groups are never summed (amendment 8). |
| **Eager mode** | Its backbone ships `@torch.compile(fullgraph=True, max_autotune=True)` and upstream recommends CUDA graphs; both disabled uniformly. **For latency this makes its Gate 3 number an UPPER BOUND. For quality the effect is `NOT MEASURED`** — compiled-vs-eager numerical equivalence has not been verified here and is not asserted in either direction. |
| **Licence** | ⚠️ **AGPL-3.0, permanent, unconditional:** `RESEARCH / ARCHITECTURE EVIDENCE — NOT SHIPPABLE AS A CLOSED-PRODUCT DEPENDENCY UNDER THE CURRENT LICENCE.` The label travels with every quality number. **`external_agpl/` stays gitignored and out of any published tree.** No decoded WAV produced by this arm is published without that label. |
| **Provenance** | Weakest of any arm — Google Drive via `gdown`, no revision, no content addressing; our own sha256 `c47a1e85…f2333` is the only pin. Recorded on every MelFlow row. |
| **Upstream repairs** | Two DECLARED repairs to `sp-uhh/streamfm` @ `ab2700c1`, both independently verified INERT (no weight, no arithmetic touched). Disclosed on the arm's rows, unchanged. |

## 10. ⛔ Reuse map — imported, never re-derived

**Re-deriving frozen geometry will silently disagree with Gates 2 and 3.**
`gate4_run.py` imports; it does not restate.

| quantity | imported from | why it is not re-derived |
|---|---|---|
| true integer hop `samples_per_unit` | `gate2_matrix.json` → `samples_per_unit_measured`, via **`gate3_arms.gate2()`** | recovered exactly from `L(u) = a·u + b`. Deriving it from the measured token rate once made `mimi_q8` read **+7.24 … +72.37 samples/chunk** where the truth is **0**. |
| frame period / atomic quantum | `gate2_matrix.json` → `quantum_ms`, and `gate3_arms.Arm.quantum_units` | amendment 1. Off-grid fragments already produced a VOID run once. |
| streaming labels, C1/C2, `emits_pcm_from_partial_input` | `gate2_matrix.json` | frozen. **Gate 4 does not reclassify streaming.** |
| §8 streamed-validity verdicts | `gate3_matrix.json` → `stream[].streamed_gate8` | an arm failing §8 has no valid streaming configuration at that size |
| **E3 minimum viable configuration** | `gate3_matrix.json` → `e3_min_viable_streaming_ms` + the matching `stream[].chunk_units` | §8.2 above |
| §8 verdicts / the validity function | **`gate3_lib.validity()`** | one definition, so a fix cannot reach one arm and miss another (R6) |
| the chunking detector | **`gate_lib.err()`** | identical definition for every arm, and it carries its DETECTOR label |
| seam metrics | **`gate3_lib.seam_metrics()`** | §10.6, frozen before any output was heard |
| delay estimation machinery | **`gate3_lib.estimate_delay()`** | the *function* is reused; the frozen probe *values* are not (they measured `reliable: false`) |
| exact unit counts | **`gate3_run.units_for()`** | exact produced-audio denominators, with the cache clamp that stopped Mimi's 30 s cell being silently skipped |
| the adapter interface | **`gate3_arms.py` (+ `_b`, `_fish`), `gate3_run_melflow.py`** | seven operations per arm, already correct for all 19. **No new per-arm decode path is written.** |
| streaming path selection | **`arm.state_constructible`** | the 3 causal Focal arms stream statefully; every other arm streams stateless. Same flag Gates 2 and 3 used. |
| encode-once-and-cache discipline | **`gate3_run.cached_rep()`** pattern | the encoder runs once per (arm, utterance), its output is hashed, and every decode comes from that cache |
| seed | `gate3_lib.SEED = 20260911` | one seed across the study |
| §8 predicate constants | `gate_lib.MIN_ENERGY_RATIO / MAX_ENERGY_RATIO / DURATION_TOL_FRAMES` | unchanged |

**`gate4_lib.py` contains only what is genuinely new: the tier-B and tier-C
metrics, the alignment gate, the determinism gate, the resampler wrapper, and
the corpus manifest reader.** Everything else is an import.

## 11. ⛔ Claim boundaries — carried in, plus the one new rule

All of `GATE4_HANDOFF.md` §8 applies unchanged. Restated where Gate 4 could
plausibly breach it:

1. **Measured: REPRESENTATION → WAVEFORM only.** Route A numbers are **round-trip**, attributed to the route (§1). Generator quality is unmeasured.
2. **Route A and Route B are NEVER merged into one ranking.** Two tables, always.
3. **`mimi_q8` and `mimi_q32` are never merged.** `n_q` on every row. n_q=32 is **never** "Mimi 1.1 kbps".
4. **codec targets/s is a property of the REPRESENTATION ONLY** — not generator decisions/s, not Transformer evaluations/s.
5. **Seam and Q1 metrics compare a decoder against ITSELF.** They are not a quality ranking between decoders, in any output.
6. **The chunking error metric is a DETECTOR, not a severity scale.** Cross-arm severity rankings from it stay WITHDRAWN.
7. **Evidence vocabulary on every field.** A blank never means unknown; a zero never means unmeasured.
8. **Vendor anchors (75 / 50 / 200 ms) are vendor-reported market anchors**, not comparable to anything here. Gate 4 produces no quality anchor of that kind at all.
9. **Eager mode for every arm.** For quality, compiled-vs-eager equivalence is `NOT MEASURED`.
10. **Every failure is a recorded row carrying its state.**
11. **Negative capability claims need evidence** (R13). "We did not build an overlap-add stage" is a fact about this study; "MelFlow cannot stream to PCM" is a different claim and is not supported by it.
12. **Declare the domain, never enumerate the failures** (R19). **Nobody certifies their own verifier.**
13. **`nanocodec` stays BLOCKED**, no manufactured number, every format.
14. **Amendments append below the amendment line** with a date and an explicit statement of whether results had been seen.

### 11.1 ⭐ The new rule — when, and only when, `QUALITY COMPARISON NOT ESTABLISHED` may be lifted

`PROTOCOL.md` §10.6 and §16.2 both carry it. Gate 4 exists to earn it, and the
conditions are frozen **now**, before any number exists:

> **`QUALITY COMPARISON NOT ESTABLISHED` is lifted for a specific pair of arms
> only when ALL SIX hold:**
>
> 1. the comparison is **within one route** (A with A, B with B);
> 2. it names **one specific metric** that the §6 fuzz suite classified as a
>    **SEVERITY SCALE**, not a DETECTOR. ⭐ **MEASURED, all six states, delta repair: exactly ONE
>    metric qualifies — `mcd`.** `ltas_gainmatched` briefly appeared to qualify
>    and was **DEMOTED by measurement** under gate G6 (§6.1.3), not by
>    preference. Every other implemented metric is a
>    detector for a measured reason (§6.1). **So every cross-arm quality ranking
>    Gate 4 can produce rests on `mcd` alone, under REFERENCE-COMMON, and that
>    narrowness is stated wherever a ranking appears.**
> 3. it names **which denominator** — REFERENCE-NATIVE or REFERENCE-COMMON — and
>    the statement holds under **both**, or the table says which one it holds
>    under;
> 4. both arms' cells are **`MEASURED`**: §8 PASS, determinism PASS, and for a
>    tier-B metric the alignment gate passed on the same utterances, with the
>    judged and unjudged counts printed;
> 5. **BOTH** of the following hold — see §11.2.5, rewritten for D2:
>    **(a)** the paired effect's **95% recording-cluster bootstrap interval
>    EXCLUDES ZERO**; and
>    **(b)** the effect magnitude **exceeds the MEASURED, STATE-AWARE
>    INSTRUMENT FLOOR** of §6.1.2, **evaluated in ABSOLUTE `mcd` UNITS**.
>    Single-state: that state's absolute floor.
>    ⭐ **POOLED: the MAXIMUM ABSOLUTE floor over every contributing state —
>    NEVER the largest fraction.** Over all six that is
>    **105.07 (Scared)**.
>    ⛔ **The fractional rule is WITHDRAWN (M1): it named Whisper (0.9753) whose
>    absolute floor is 84.59, where Scared's 105.07 binds —
>    under-protecting by 24.2%.** An unknown or unrecognised
>    state **FAILS CLOSED** — never zero, never a mean, never another state's floor.
>    ⛔ **`rate_chain_floor` is NO LONGER the bar (D2): it returns exactly 0.0
>    for 15 of 18 arms**, because those arms have `sr_in == sr_out`, and 28.4 for
>    the three 16k→24k causal Focal arms — vacuous for most and arbitrary for the
>    rest.
> 6. the sentence says **round trip**, not "decoder" — unless it is **Q3**, the
>    controlled pair, where identical tokens make it decoder-attributable.
>
> **Where any one fails, `QUALITY COMPARISON NOT ESTABLISHED` stands for that
> pair, and it is displayed as a state, not hidden as a blank.**

⛔ **Lifting it for one pair never lifts it globally, and it is never lifted by
an aggregate over a route.**
